label: wild plum / cherry
note: fruit only; pits and leaves are toxic

label: mulberry
note: ripe fruit; unripe fruit and sap irritate

label: elderberry
note: cooked ripe berries and flowers; other parts toxic

label: sumac
note: red berry clusters for tea; white-berried poison sumac is a different genus

label: prickly pear
note: fruit and pads after removing spines

label: wild onion / ramps
note: check for death camas: no onion smell means no

label: daylily
note: buds and tubers; some people react

label: pine
note: nuts and needle tea; some pines are toxic to livestock

label: ginkgo
note: cooked seeds in small amounts; fruit pulp irritates

label: Kentucky coffeetree
note: seeds only after roasting; raw is toxic

label: mayapple
note: only the fully ripe fruit; all other parts are poisonous

label: wild carrot
note: poison hemlock and water hemlock look alike

label: black locust
note: flowers only; the rest is toxic

label: honeysuckle
note: flower nectar only; berries of many are toxic
